;Business and economy
*[[Nicotine marketing]]
**[[Michigan]] becomes the first state in the United States to ban the sale of flavored [[electronic cigarette]]s, which the state government says are marketed towards children. [https://www.mlive.com/news/2019/09/michigan-becomes-first-state-to-ban-flavored-e-cigarettes.html (MLive.com)]

;Disasters and accidents
*[[New Zealand]] police confirm that a bus carrying 27 [[Chinese people|Chinese]] tourists crashed in bad weather near [[Rotorua]] and left at least five dead and six injured. [https://news.sky.com/story/new-zealand-bus-crash-five-tourists-killed-after-vehicle-rolls-over-near-rotorua-11801817 (Sky News)]
*[[Hurricane Dorian]]
**Hurricane Dorian increases to a [[Saffir–Simpson scale|Category Three]] storm as it approaches [[The Carolinas]] in the [[United States]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/weather/2019/09/04/hurricane-dorian-poised-slam-carolinas-after-scraping-by-coasts-florida-georgia/ (''The Washington Post'')]
**At least 20 people are known to have been killed by Hurricane Dorian in [[the Bahamas]]. [https://www.wavy.com/news/world/20-people-now-confirmed-dead-in-bahamas-after-hurricane-dorian/ (WAVY-TV)]
* [[Hurricane Dorian–Alabama controversy]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Donald Trump]] [[False or misleading statements by Donald Trump#Hurricane Dorian|uses an altered map]] showing the projected forecast of [[Hurricane Dorian]] in order to support a disputed claim that [[Alabama]] has recently been threatened by the storm. If deliberate, the action is a [[Title 18 of the United States Code|federal offense]]. [https://www.newsweek.com/trump-hurricane-dorian-alabama-altered-map-law-1457793 (''Newsweek'')]

;Law and crime
*[[2019 Samoa assassination plot]]
**After an [[assassination]] plot to kill [[Prime Minister of Samoa|Samoan Prime Minister]] [[Tuilaepa Aiono Sailele Malielegaoi|Tuilaepa A. S. Malielegaoi]] is foiled, police are working to extradite a [[Samoans|Samoan]] man who lives in [[Brisbane]], Australia. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/398081/samoa-assassination-plot-thickens-with-extradition-application (Radio New Zealand)]
*[[2019 Hong Kong anti-extradition bill protests]]
**[[Hong Kong]] [[Chief Executive of Hong Kong|Chief Executive]] [[Carrie Lam]] announces the formal withdrawal of the controversial [[2019 Hong Kong extradition bill|extradition bill]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-hongkong-protests/hong-kong-leader-to-announce-withdrawal-of-controversial-extradition-bill-media-idUSKCN1VP05B (Reuters)]
*[[Privacy concerns regarding Google]]
**[[Google]] agrees to pay a record [[US$]]170 million penalty to settle accusations that [[YouTube]] broke the law when it knowingly tracked and sold advertisements to children, the [[Federal Trade Commission]] says. [https://www.cnn.com/2019/09/04/tech/google-youtube-ftc-settlement/index.html (CNN)]
*A [[US]] federal judge rules in favour of 23 citizens who sued after being placed on a terrorism watchlist, saying the list violates their [[US constitution|constitutional rights]]. [https://edition.cnn.com/2019/09/04/politics/terrorism-screening-database/index.html (CNN)]
;Politics and elections
*[[Brexit]]
**The [[House of Commons of the United Kingdom]] approves a bill to block a [[no-deal Brexit]] next month, by a vote of 327 to 299. The bill instructs [[Prime Minister Boris Johnson]] to request another [[Brexit]] extension if he cannot secure a deal with the [[European Union]] in the coming weeks. [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/09/04/world/europe/brexit-boris-johnson-parliament.html?fbclid=IwAR1Tmf1OV3OlNZmfxjPI76bt0dLzEgcKh789P3ofTA1ZE0754trfSiLqMA0 (''The New York Times'')]
**The [[House of Commons of the United Kingdom|House of Commons]] rejects [[Prime Minister of the United Kingdom|Prime Minister]] [[Boris Johnson]]'s motion to hold a [[Next United Kingdom general election|general election]] in October amid continuing political deadlock over [[Brexit]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/uk-politics-49584907 (BBC News)]
*[[Politics of Turkey]]
**[[President of Turkey|Turkish President]] [[Recep Tayyip Erdoğan]] says he [[Nuclear proliferation|cannot accept that]] his country is [[Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons|not allowed to possess nuclear weapons]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-turkey-nuclear-erdogan/erdogan-says-its-unacceptable-that-turkey-cant-have-nuclear-weapons-idUSKCN1VP2QN (Reuters)]
*[[2020 Democratic Party presidential debates and forums]]
**[[CNN]] hosts a seven-hour [[town hall meeting|town hall]] on [[global warming|climate change]] featuring ten [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic]] [[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries|presidential candidates]]. An official debate sponsored by the Democratic Party had previously been shot down by the [[Democratic National Committee|DNC]].  [https://www.vox.com/policy-and-politics/2019/9/3/20847535/cnn-climate-town-hall-2020-presidential-democrats (''Vox'')]
